summary: The code is syntactically valid, imports are satisfied, and it runs a coherent agent-based simulation with modules for risk, mobility, enforcement, information, social influence, adoption, and retail market. However, it diverges from the provided task specification in several key implementation areas: entity attributes do not match the spec, several required metrics and validation criteria are missing or misnamed, and some behaviors/outputs (e.g., average mask price over time, policy effect size, steady-state adoption) are not implemented. Error handling is mostly robust but overly silent. Performance is acceptable for the given defaults. The main() function is correctly called at global scope.

issues.description: Entity attributes and structure do not align with the Task Specification. Person lacks many required attributes (sex, socioeconomic_status, mask_attitude, mask_use, conformity_trait, stubbornness, trust_public_health, trust_media, policy_awareness, perceived_cost_mask, access_to_masks, mobility_rate). Household, PublicHealthAuthority, MediaSource names/fields differ, and WorkplaceSchool/PublicSpace are merged into a generic Location.
issues.location: Dataclasses: Person, Household, Location, Government, Media
issues.solution: Refactor entities to include the specified attributes and classes: Person, Household, WorkplaceSchool, PublicSpace, PublicHealthAuthority, Retailer, MediaSource. Map current fields to the spec (e.g., trust_in_authority -> trust_public_health) and add missing attributes with initializations and behavior usage.

issues.description: Required metrics from the specification are missing or not aligned. Specifically: steady_state_adoption (final 14 days average) is not computed; policy_effect_size (DiD) is not computed; ses_disparity_index is approximated as inequality_in_adoption but not explicitly exposed; stockout_frequency (proportion of days) is missing; average_mask_price over time is not captured; infections_averted is not modeled.
issues.solution: Add time series recording for average_mask_price; compute steady_state_adoption as the mean of the last 14 days; compute policy_effect_size using pre/post windows relative to mandate_day or a control; compute ses_disparity_index per spec; compute stockout_frequency as share of days with stockouts; optionally implement a simple transmission model to estimate infections_averted or document the omission.

issues.description: Validation criteria required by the specification are not implemented. No explicit checks for convergence_of_adoption, or reporting of inventory_feasibility beyond implicit non-negative enforcement.
issues.location: No explicit validation function; compute_summary_metrics does not include validation outputs
issues.solution: Implement validation checks: (1) convergence_of_adoption: absolute change over the final 7 days < threshold; (2) inventory_feasibility: assert and track any negative stock events and report; (3) calibration_fit_optional: if GT available, compute RMSE and compare to threshold.

issues.description: Parameter names and semantics deviate from the specification (e.g., policy_mandate_day, messaging_frequency_per_week, mask_price_base, retailer restock parameters).
issues.solution: Align parameter keys with the spec and map existing ones where reasonable (e.g., mandate_start_day -> policy_mandate_day, mask_price -> mask_price_base). Add or translate missing parameters to maintain spec compatibility.

issues.description: Enforcement deterrence is only applied to individuals who are checked/caught on that day; the spec suggests broader deterrence via policy mandates and venue enforcement.
issues.solution: Add a baseline deterrence signal for all noncompliant individuals in locations with active enforcement/mandate, scaled by enforcement level and visibility, not only those checked.

issues.description: The simulation uses 'income' and a high_income_threshold to proxy SES disparity but does not implement 'socioeconomic_status' attribute as requested.
issues.solution: Add socioeconomic_status attribute (e.g., categorical or quantile-based) and compute ses_disparity_index per spec using that attribute.

issues.description: Numerous try/except blocks swallow exceptions silently, which hampers debugging.
issues.location: ensure_dir, ParameterManager.load_param_file, save_used, Simulation.save_results/save_artifacts, load_ground_truth, etc.
issues.solution: Log warnings/errors or at least print concise messages when exceptions occur, optionally guarded by a verbose/debug flag.

issues.description: Default calibration budget (10) runs full simulations per trial; acceptable for N≈600, T≈120 but may be heavy in constrained environments.
issues.solution: Respect a fast_mode setting to downscale N/T during calibration or reduce budget by default when QUICK_TEST or fast flags are active.

issues.description: Average mask price over time is not recorded, though it's used internally for decisions.
issues.solution: Record daily average price across retailers in observables (e.g., average_mask_price_daily) and aggregate to the required metric.
